notes: Throws org.testng.SkipException at the start of the test whenever the CI environment variable is set, so TestNG reports the test as skipped instead of running it. Rejected: throwing SkipException outside a catch is a disable. The throw sits under an if, since an unconditional throw would make the rest of the method unreachable and fail to compile. Built on the killbill commit of reject-testng-retry-analyzer: instead of adding retryAnalyzer to @Test, the three hand written lines go at the start of the method body, and the message reuses the commit's own comment, "Flaky, see https://github.com/killbill/killbill/issues/860".
